ada.text: Good morning, everyone! I started on the green with a wave, then sat a while on the bench outside the cottage, thinking of my bees. After that I took a lovely swim in the pond, and now I'm here with you. It's been a cheerful, quiet morning.

bo.text: Um... hi, I'm Bo. This morning I tried the reading room, but it was closed, so I wandered out to the orchard instead. It was quiet there, and I hummed a little tune to myself. Then I walked back here. I'm glad it's a small crowd.
